text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear three-part structure with \"Firstly,\" \"Second reason,\" and \"Finally\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its points in a clear sequence that makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"specific references to work zones, sensors, and liability in paragraph 9","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay supports its claims with concrete details drawn from the article rather than only broad assertions."},{"evidence":"explains how sensor failure could lead to a crash and why liability would be unclear","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more fully connects evidence to its claims by showing how and why the problems would happen."},{"evidence":"states that driverless cars are unsafe, can malfunction, and create legal problems","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay presents multiple relevant reasons that are each expanded into a defensible line of argument."},{"evidence":"returns to the same concerns in the conclusion","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay closes by restating its main claims in a way that reinforces the position."}]}
